bullets.text: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Launch - Samsung's next Unpacked event in London will unveil the Galaxy Z Fold 8 on July 22.
Apple TV's Criminal Record Returns - Season 2 of the acclaimed London crime thriller premieres on April 22.
iOS 26 Messages Upgrade - The Messages app now features enhanced search capabilities using natural language.
Spotify Focus Mode - A new feature allows users to disable videos, enhancing the audio experience.
iPadOS 26.4 Enhancements - New features improve multitasking for power users with better window management.
iPhone 18 Pro Camera Simplification - Rumored updates may simplify the Camera Control button for better usability.
Nvidia-Backed SiFive Valuation - SiFive reaches a $3.65 billion valuation, focusing on open AI chip designs.
Generalist AI's Robot Dexterity - New AI model enables robots to perform complex tasks like stuffing cash into wallets.
Artemis II Astronauts Return - NASA's Artemis II crew successfully splashed down after their historic moon mission.
